title: Adaptive triage for customer analytics coverage and export scenarios
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design and implement an adaptive triage and prioritization flow for console reporting and export requests from enterprise customers. This ticket covers the intake form, automated scoring heuristics, SLA mapping (bronze/silver/gold), and routing rules that determine when a request becomes a dedicated roadmap item vs. a quick self-serve enhancement. Primary goals: reduce manual PM triage time, surface high-impact enterprise asks earlier, and ensure requests that require compliance (data residency/KMS/air-gap) are flagged and routed to Private/Dedicated tracks.
acceptance_criteria: A new intake form template available in the Console 'Request a report' flow with fields for frequency, export formats, expected row volumes, downstream consumers, and compliance requirements
Automated scoring returns a coverage_score (0-100) and reason tags (e.g., 'security', 'volume', 'billing-impact') for each request visible in the triage queue
Routing rules can map requests to: 'Self-serve enhancements', 'Product backlog', or 'Enterprise SOW' and a default SLA bucket: Bronze(30d)/Silver(14d)/Gold(5d)
PMs can override automated routing with an audit log entry and a short justification
Telemetry events emitted for intake form submissions and routing decisions (schema reviewed in ENG-21456)
Design mockups and a small cross-team prototype (Console + Analytics) exist and have sign-off from Design and Security
proposed_flow_changes: Add 'Use case template' selector to intake form (Billing, Usage Analytics, Cost Forecasting, Third-party ETL)
New fields: expected export cadence, max monthly row count, format preference (CSV/Parquet), sample schema, required retention window
Scoring heuristic: 40% customer ARR & seat count, 25% operational frequency, 20% compliance/regulatory flag, 15% engineering complexity estimate
Routing rules with thresholds: coverage_score >= 75 => Enterprise SOW lane; 40-74 => Backlog lane with SLA Silver; <40 => Self-serve/Docs with Bronze SLA
Integration point: Console 'Requests' view shows scoring breakdown and links to related dashboards and existing exports
prioritization_matrix: High ARR + High Frequency => Priority lane (auto-flag for PM review)
Compliance flag (data residency/KMS/air-gap) => Auto-assign to Private deploy intake and Security review
Low cost impact + low frequency => Recommend self-serve template and documentation chatflow
Requests that duplicate existing exports => auto-link to existing PR/feature (if confidence > 80%)
engineering_notes: Spike required to enumerate telemetry events and canonical 'export_request' schema (ENG-21456 owns schema work)
Need a small API endpoint to accept intake submissions and return a scoring payload; auth will use existing Console token
Backend: scoring should be pluggable (start with a deterministic rule engine; later replace with ML model if necessary)
Work to surface routing and audit logs in the Console will require 3 frontend components and a small migration in the requests DB schema
Privacy: when customers upload sample schema or sample rows, files must be stored encrypted with KMS and accessible only to authorized reviewers
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): enable adaptive triage for 10 enterprise workspaces with >$25k ARR for 4 weeks
Phase 2: broaden to all enterprise workspaces and add 'Use case templates' in the Console
Phase 3: release auto-routing to backlog and Enterprise SOW lanes; monitor false positives and adjust thresholds
Communication: target email and in-console banners; host a 'triage office hours' session for Solutions Engineers
